title: exec-staff-meeting-prep-notes-priya-2026-03-27
content:
Objective: Prep for Exec Staff sync on 2026-03-27 (30m). Focus: roadmap alignment, Q2 capacity commit asks, major risks, and customer escalations.

Agenda (30m):
- 0-5m: Quick wins & customer escalations (Priya)
- 5-12m: Hosted API performance update + canary rollout status (Maya)
- 12-20m: Dedicated capacity forecast & commit ask (Ethan)
- 20-26m: Private deployment pipeline / compliance checklist (Connor)
- 26-30m: Decisions needed + action items (Priya)

Key points to surface:
- Hosted API: median gen latency steady at 120ms P50; tail (P99) improved from 750ms -> 420ms after kernel switch on 3/20, but some customers still see spikes tied to longer-context requests. Need confirmation on auto-fallback policy effectiveness and whether to widen canary to an additional 5% of traffic next week.
- Dedicated: Renewal conversations with three mid-market customers this quarter. Capacity ask: propose a $500k commit for Dedicated Q3 to reserve additional 40 A100-equivalent slots to guarantee throughput for 2 large customers. Need approval to surface proposal to Sales leadership.
- Private: Compliance checklist for EU PII ingestion - privacy team signed off on updated KMS flow but SRE flagged audit log retention gaps for on-prem installers. Timeline for fix: 2 weeks.
- Optimize product: Early experiments with adaptive batching showing 18-22% token-cost savings on chat workloads. We should propose an opt-in pilot for 2 enterprise customers to gather telemetry and estimate annualized savings.

Customer escalations to mention:
- AcmeHealth: intermittent 5xx during high concurrent inference loads; Hotfix applied yesterday but we need to schedule a postmortem with their platform engineers. Owner: Connor.
- FinX: concerned about latency regressions in private deployment; CG-it ticket FINX-22 open, sales engaged. Owner: Maya.

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: Capacity overcommit if we approve Dedicated commit without conservative headroom assumptions. Mitigation: propose 15% buffer and conditional clauses in the contract for burst capacity.
- Risk: Auto-rollout of new kernel could cause unexpected regressions at scale. Mitigation: hold-back for customers with long-context requests and increase canary to 10% with enhanced tracing.

Decisions we want from execs:
1) Approve the $500k Dedicated Q3 capacity ask (yes/no) or ask for revised proposal.
2) Approve expansion of kernel canary to +5% traffic next week.
3) Authorize a 2-customer pilot for Redwood Optimize adaptive batching.

Prep notes for presenters:
- Maya: have P50/P95/P99 graphs for last 30d and note specific customers affected by P99 spikes. Bring canary tracing snippets.
- Ethan: prepare capacity plan slide with committed vs headroom scenarios and revenue impact. Include suggested contract language for burst capacity.
- Connor: summarize audit-log gaps and timeline for fix; include plan for AcmeHealth postmortem scheduling.

Follow-up items to assign during meeting: see action_items list.

Notes to self / talking points (Priya):
- Keep ask crisp: dollars, what we deliver, risks, fallback.
- Emphasize customer momentum on Dedicated renewals; show revenue confidence intervals.
- If execs push back on commit size, offer staged commit with opt-out clauses tied to observed utilization.
- For Optimize pilot, propose commercial terms: free pilot for 60 days + credit toward first-year usage-based fee if we meet reported savings threshold.

Quick reference metrics (to read aloud):
- Hosted API tokens/day: 2.1B avg last 7d
- Peak concurrent requests: 9.4k
- SLO violations (last 7d): 12 incidents, majority due to external infra flakiness
action_items: Priya Shah - finalize Dedicated Q3 commit proposal and share with Sales leadership - due 2026-03-30
Maya Liu - bring P50/P95/P99 latency slides + canary traces to the sync - due 2026-03-27
Ethan Cole - produce capacity plan slide with headroom scenarios and suggested contract language - due 2026-03-29
Connor Brooks - schedule AcmeHealth postmortem and confirm audit-log retention fix timeline - due 2026-04-10
Priya Shah & Product Ops - draft Optimize pilot commercial terms and pilot success metrics - due 2026-03-31
Maya Liu - update FINX ticket with private deployment mitigation steps and confirm next steps with Sales - due 2026-03-28
